concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished, high-resolution landscape image of a complete native macOS application window for All Set, a desktop themes and widgets customization app. Straight-on orthographic screenshot, window fills the image with just a slim outer dark margin, approximately 16:10 aspect ratio. Pixel-sharp interface, meticulously aligned layout, readable SF Pro-like typography, realistic understated macOS glass materials, crisp icons and hairline borders. Premium creative application, dark cinematic navy-black, subtle blue/cyan/indigo atmospheric lighting, carefully controlled highlight glows, generous spacing, strong visual hierarchy. Native red yellow green traffic lights at upper left followed by wordmark "All Set". Persistent first navigation row centered: "Island", "Desktop" selected, "Workspace", "Tools", "System". Second smaller navigation row: "Themes" selected, "Widgets", "Favorites", "Wallpaper", "Look & Layout", "On Your Desktop". Keep navigation readable and evenly spaced. Desktop utility icon buttons at upper right. Actual theme previews must show a complete composed desktop with tasteful clock, calendar, weather, music and photo widgets over coordinated wallpaper, never just unrelated wallpaper images. Include a readable search control "Search themes" and category chips "All", "Featured", "Moodboards", "Football", "Music", "Minimal", "Dark". Theme names available: "Seven", "City Noir", "Americana", "Albiceleste", "Cloud Nine", "Peach Fizz", "Matcha Morning". "Seven" uses original moody red football imagery, shirt number 7, stadium lighting; no real athlete likeness, club crest, sponsor or official branding. "City Noir" uses monochrome architecture and beautifully sparse widgets; "Americana" warm sunset and palms; "Albiceleste" icy blue-white football aesthetic; "Cloud Nine" soft misty lavender; "Peach Fizz" warm peach horizon; "Matcha Morning" sage greenery. Every interactive element feels feasible in SwiftUI. Clean realistic shippable design, no code, no implementation notes, no browser chrome, no device hardware, no photographs of a laptop, no marketing collage, no illegible decorative paragraphs, no excessive neon, no watermarks. This is a design selection mockup for the existing Themes section, only frontend exploration. Concept 1 — CINEMATIC CAROUSEL. Place a concise page header "Themes" with understated subtitle "A new mood for your desktop." at upper left below navigation and search at upper right. Main content is an exquisitely composed large glass stage, blue-magenta ambience behind it. Five portrait theme cards arranged across the stage with believable subtle perspective and depth, center card significantly larger, side cards receding but their names still readable. Center selected theme "Seven": rich crimson stadium wallpaper with original red number-7 shirt, carefully curated clock and music widget collage; clean bottom gradient with "Seven", "12 widgets", small "Featured" badge, clear white capsule "Apply Theme" and secondary outlined "Preview", small favorite heart. Neighbor cards City Noir and Albiceleste, outer cards Americana and Cloud Nine. Refined thin color rims, quiet ground glow beneath selected card, shallow glass highlights, plenty of separation, no visual obstruction to card labels. Place carousel arrow buttons at stage sides and modest pagination. Categories in a distinct glass pill rail just below stage. Lower part of screenshot includes a "Curated for you" horizontal rail of four smaller landscape desktop theme previews, title and widget count under each, a "See all" text link. Include a small quiet switch labeled "Change wallpaper too". Main hero occupies about half the available content height so lower collection is visible. Finished app screenshot with exceptional image detail and coherent spacing.
